about: src/lib/cart_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-money line: cart_line_unit, cart_line_total, cart_subtotal, combo_extras; the server charges a cart line with it at intake). features/public-ordering/pricing.test.ts runs the storefront cart (lineUnitPrice, lineTotal, cartSubtotal; the wasm) against it. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
